course_name_original: Fundamentos de Ciencia de los Materiales

learning_outcomes.text: Know the classification of materials and their properties according to their chemical foundations.
Understand the relationship between microstructure, synthesis or processing, and material properties.
Able to perform laboratory tests to characterize material behavior.
Able to work in a team, apply critical reasoning, make decisions, and communicate knowledge and conclusions in the field of industrial engineering.

syllabus_topics: Crystalline structure of materials and their defects.
teaching_methods: Classroom presentations of concepts and problem-solving sessions (lectures, discussion classes, sharing sessions).
Personal study, report writing, practical assignments (independent work).
assessment_rules: Students can pass by continuous assessment based on a first partial (30%), second partial (30%), practicals (25%), and assignments (15%). A minimum of 4 points is required in partial exams or lab practicals to compensate with other grades and achieve a minimum total of 5. Attendance at practicals is mandatory for continuous assessment; if practicals are failed but the rest of the subject is passed, only the practical exam needs to be approved in the Ordinary Call. Students not achieving 5/10 points must retake failed partials in the June ordinary call. If the subject is not passed in the June Ordinary Call, a final exam worth 100% of the grade must be taken in the July Extraordinary Call, with no parts exempted.
